title: Local-first monorepo: pnpm + TS/ESM library + CLI + CI (build/test/lint)
context: Systematic-Review-Assist needs a local-first project skeleton before any feature can be built. The tool runs as a library + CLI on the reviewer's own machine so that closed full text never has to leave their machine. It follows Elyos conventions: TypeScript, ESM, pnpm workspaces. The monorepo will host the core library (@elyos/sra-core), CLI (@elyos/sra-cli), and later an optional local web UI. No partner or review team is yet secured; verifiedNeed is false.
objective: Scaffold the local-first pnpm monorepo with TypeScript/ESM packages for the core library and CLI, wire up a CI pipeline that runs build, test, and lint on every PR, and confirm the skeleton compiles and tests pass with zero failures.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm workspace contains at least two packages: @elyos/sra-core (library) and @elyos/sra-cli (CLI entry point); both compile under TypeScript strict mode with ESM output
CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent) runs pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint on every push and PR; the pipeline is green on an empty implementation
The CLI is executable locally (e.g., node dist/cli.js --help) and prints a usage message without error
No secrets, tokens, or API keys are committed or logged; .gitignore covers node_modules, dist, and any .env files
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint all pass from the repo root
output: A merged PR containing the pnpm/TS/ESM monorepo skeleton with @elyos/sra-core and @elyos/sra-cli packages, a working CI pipeline, and green build/test/lint checks.
